paragraphs.text: The Isles of the Scarabs are an archipelago in the Sea of Serenity , south of Jamuraa on the plane of Dominaria .

Around 3334 AR , Adira Strongheart and her Robaran Mercenaries conquered a Lucrezian ship led by Lieutenant Orville . Inside its cabin, they found a map that was encrypted with false coordinates, but after some pondering, they figured out that the map pointed past the Isles of the Scarabs, to a volcanic island named Unawanna .
